name: Circle of Crawling (Druid Circle)
body:
The most numerous members of nature’s domain are those noticed the least: those that crawl and hide and dig. But without them, nothing else would survive.

Bonus Spells: jump (1st), vomit swarm (2nd), vermin shape I (3rd), vermin shape II (4th), insect plague (5th), swarm skin (6th), creeping doom (7th), verminous transformation (8th), mind blank (9th).

Manifestation: Your movements are somewhat unnatural, with your joints occasionally moving in the wrong direction.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Insect Movement (Ex)

You can move like an insect. You have a climb speed equal to your speed, and you can move at your full speed while prone by crawling, provided you have two hands free. You are not affected by web effects.

Toxic Touch (Su)

At 8th level, you can cause your instantaneous spells to become toxic. Whenever an instantaneous legendary druid spell you cast affects a creature, you may poison them.

The creature takes damage equal to your class level and they are nauseated for 1 round, unless they make a successful Fortitude saving throw against a DC equal to 10 + half your class level + your Wisdom modifier. A successful save negates the nausea and the damage.

As a standard action, you may subject a creature within 30 feet to your poison. No attack roll is required, but the target still receives a saving throw against the effect.

Creatures immune to poison are immune to this ability.

Personal Swarm (Su)

At 16th level, a swarm of insects inhabit the area around your body. Your swarm has a total number of hit points equal to your total number of hit points and can damage enemies within 30 feet of you. As a standard action, you may cause both your swarm and an enemy within 30 feet to lose up to 2 hit points per class level you possess. Your swarm cannot inflict more damage than its current hit point total. If your swarm is reduced to 0 hit points, it ceases to exist until it regains at least 1 hit point.

Whenever you take damage, your blood transforms into more insects. Each hit point you lose replenishes your swarm by one hit point, up to a maximum equal to your hit point maximum.

Your swarm can take damage, and has an AC and touch AC of 25, and is immune to mind-affecting abilities. It automatically fails all saving throws.

Druidic Talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Chitinous Exoskeleton (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

As a standard action, you can grow or retract a chitinous exoskeleton. The exoskeleton works as armor with a +5 armor bonus, with no Dexterity limitation or armor check penalty.

The exoskeleton can be enchanted as separate armor and counts as wearing armor.

Control Vermin (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

Your legendary druid mind-affecting spells can affect vermin as if they were not immune to mind affecting effects. You may target vermin with spells and special abilities that only affect animals.

Insect Mind (Su)

(Grand Talent)

Mind-affecting spells no longer affect you unless you allow them to, or unless they could also affect vermin or mindless creatures.

Scavenger (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

You gain the scent ability and are immune to ingested poisons.

You can gain sustenance from eating any organic material (even wood) and can drink blood in place of water.
